claims.assertion: Swaruu (9) says Triton’s subsurface life draws on geothermal energy; Andromedans allegedly towed it into retrograde orbit as a Neptune counterweight.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: She describes Ceres, formerly Tiamat’s moon, as hosting Federation bases and cities for ship resupply, repairs, and trade.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: She describes O’ha’lu as a subterranean Mantis civilization under tiered councils; despite claimed neutrality, it has negative treaties and Federation monitoring.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

claims.assertion: She attributes the solar system’s apparent missing mass to Kuiper Belt debris plus O’ha’lu, but says this falls short of human gravitational estimates.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)

review_flags: Swaruu (9) says the O’ha’lu Mantis are related to but distinct from Mars Mantis; she describes their role in human extraction as indirect through sauroid raiders’ use of their bases.
